map.核反应 Q 值计算器 使用指南: Nuclear Reaction Q Value Calculator User Guide
map.核反应 Q 值计算器依据反应前后质量差乘 c² 求能量释放或吸收，判断核反应放能: The nuclear reaction Q value calculator multiplies the mass difference between reactants and products by c^2 to obtain the energy released or absorbed, judging whether the reaction is exothermic or endothermic, which suits nuclear physics study and reactor or fusion analysis.
map.反应前后质量差对应的能量释放。: The energy released corresponding to the mass difference before and after the reaction.
map.Q = (mᵢ − m_f)·c² 由初末质量差得反应释能。: Q = (mi - mf)*c^2 gives the released energy from the initial-to-final mass difference.
map.判断核反应吸热/放热。: Determine whether a nuclear reaction is endothermic or exothermic.
map.对比不同反应的质量差。: Compare the mass differences of different reactions.
map.：Q = (4.0026 − 4.0015) × 931.5 ≈ 0.0011: Q = (4.0026 - 4.0015) x 931.5 = 0.0011 x 931.5 = about 1.02 MeV, so the reaction releases energy.
map.：若 m_f > m_i，则 Q 为负，需外界供能（阈能）才能发生。: If mf > mi then Q is negative, and external energy input (the threshold energy) is required for the reaction to occur.
map.由中子通量、截面与靶核数求反应率: Reaction rate from neutron flux, cross-section and target number
map.由半衰期与摩尔质量求比活度: Specific activity from half-life and molar mass
map.Q>0 一定发生吗？: Does Q > 0 Always Mean It Happens?
map.不一定，还需满足角动量、宇称与库仑势垒等条件，Q 只判能量盈亏。: Not necessarily; conditions such as angular momentum, parity and the Coulomb barrier must also be met, since Q only judges the energy balance.
map.1u·c²≈931.5 MeV，将原子质量单位差转为 MeV。: 1u*c^2 is about 931.5 MeV, converting an atomic mass unit difference into MeV.
